description: Use this when you have designed art for an app yourself and the user should get it as an editable project: App Store listing art that loops as a video (a product page header, search result, or In-App Event card or page), or a still marketing image (an X, LinkedIn or Instagram post, a link preview, a Product Hunt image, a 16:9 image, Google Play's feature graphic). Takes 1 to 4 variants (directions for the user to choose from), each a background and layers: art you draw as SVG, library pieces, the app's icon, text, and phone frames showing the app (an iPhone, the iPhone Duo open from behind and from the front...), with moves and a loop on listing art. Checks everything and returns a preview image of each variant, warnings, a design_handle for update_design, and open_url, which opens the design in the appdesigns editor, where the user keeps a direction, tweaks any layer, saves it and exports it. Nothing is public and no account is needed. The design waits 72 hours to be opened and saved.

animated.description: false for a still image (the user asked for one): the moves are kept with motion turned off, so the Motion toggle brings them back.

app_store_url.description: The app's App Store link, if it is on the App Store: the editor's preview phone then shows its real name and icon, app_icon layers use its icon, and a phone layer can show one of its App Store screenshots.

asset.description: Listing art: header (3840x1646), search_result (3840x2560), event_card (3840x2160) or event_page (2160x3840). Stills: x_post (1600x900), linkedin_post (1200x627), link_preview (1200x630), instagram_square (1080x1080), instagram_portrait (1080x1350), instagram_tall (1080x1440), product_hunt (1270x760), wide_image (1920x1080), play_feature_graphic (1024x500).

project_id.description: A project_id from list_projects (the user signed in): the new asset is saved into that saved project of theirs. Use it, not same_project_as, to add to something the user already saved.

project_name.description: The app's name. It becomes the project name in the user's appdesigns library.

same_project_as.description: The project_handle or design_handle of an earlier asset from this conversation (screenshots, a header...). The user's save then files this one in the same project, once they have saved that one.

screenshots_from.description: The project_handle of a screenshot set you made with create_project in this conversation (finished, not yet saved): a phone layer's screenshot n then shows that set's n-th capture, instead of an App Store screenshot. No sign-in needed.

variants.description: The directions, each a whole design. The first is the one you would pick.

gradient.description: A gradient instead of a plain colour; radial runs from the centre out.

angle.description: linear: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom. Default 90.

colors.description: 2 to 5 colours, evenly spread across the whole canvas.

app_icon.description: true for the app's own App Store icon (needs app_store_url), drawn with iOS corners.

flip.description: svg only: mirror it left to right.

fold.description: phone, iPhone Duo: inner-open (Unfolded), outer-closed (Cover) or outer-open (Open back, the open phone from behind); the editor's names work too.

frame_color.description: phone: a colour id of the device from list_devices; default its first.

height.description: phone only: its height as a share of the canvas height, instead of width.

id.description: Unique within the variant, such as "heart" or "headline". update_design names layers by it.

library.description: A piece from the appdesigns library by its path from search_library ("3d/3d-cube-purple.png"): SF Symbols, emoji, 3D shapes, glows, badges and more.

line_height.description: text: a multiple of the size, default 1.15.

move.description: float bobs up and down, drift wanders in a figure of eight, orbit circles its spot, sway rocks side to side, spin turns all the way round, pulse grows and shrinks, fade fades in and out, pop is a quick bounce once a cycle. Text takes float, drift or sway only. none takes a move off.

offset.description: 0 to 1: where in its cycle the layer starts, so layers sharing a move do not move in step. Default 0.

speed.description: slow (about 8 s a cycle, the default), medium (about 4 s) or fast (about 2.5 s). Rounded to whole cycles per loop, so the video loops without a seam.

opacity.description: svg, app_icon and library only. Default 1.

orientation.description: phone: upright or on its side; default the way up of the screenshot it shows, else the canvas's (Open back is always on its side).

phone.description: A phone frame showing the app: a device id from list_devices (iphone-duo, iphone-17-pro-max...). Takes width or height, frame_color, fold, orientation and screenshot.

screenshot.description: phone: show screenshot n: the n-th screen of the set screenshots_from names (your own captures), else the app's n-th App Store screenshot (app_store_url). Leave it out for an empty screen, which replace_screenshots fills.

size.description: text: font size in canvas pixels.

svg.description: Art you draw: one standalone <svg> with a viewBox and a transparent background, cropped tight to the drawing. Paths, shapes, gradients, clip paths, masks and filters only; no <text>, <image>, scripts, stroke-dasharray, feMorphology, CSS animation or outside files.

text.description: Words, stay editable in the editor. Break lines yourself with \n (at most 4 lines); nothing wraps.

tint.description: library only: recolour the piece in one flat colour (SF Symbols are white glyphs).

width.description: svg, app_icon and library: width as a share of the canvas width; the height follows the art's own shape.

x.description: Horizontal centre as a share of the canvas width (0 left edge, 1 right edge). For text: the centre of centred text, the left edge of left-aligned text, the right edge of right-aligned text.

y.description: Vertical centre as a share of the canvas height (0 top, 1 bottom). For text: the middle of the whole block.

background.description: flow sways a gradient, shift drifts the colours a little round the wheel. Default still.

color.description: Leave it out for a colour that shows on the background.

effect.description: Particles over the whole canvas. Anyone can try them; exporting them needs appdesigns Pro.

layer.description: front draws over everything, back just over the background. Default front.

seconds.description: Loop length: 5 to 30 for the header and search result (default 8), 15 to 30 for event art (default 15).

title.description: The direction's name in a few words ("Heartbeat line"). It names the screen in the editor.

name: create_design
title: Create a listing art design
